_comment: Portable Claude Code permissions for the BBC toolkit. install.py MERGES this into
<repo>/.claude/settings.json by union -- it never removes an entry the host repo
already had, so running it against a repo with its own settings is safe.
Everything here is machine-independent on purpose. The personal settings.local.json
this was distilled from had accumulated session-scoped absolute paths (scratchpad
UUIDs, C:/bump-p4p/..., one-off mvn command literals with a specific -Dtest=). Those
grant nothing on another machine and only add noise, so they are deliberately absent.
Bash(mvn:*) is the one broad entry. The 3-state differential IS a Maven invocation,
so without it every state of every candidate prompts. Drop it if you would rather
approve each build; the pipeline still works, it just asks.
